subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open fork PR for this Channels settings issue, or replace it with a fresh same-repository PR?
rationale: The source-level issue remains, but an open fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test patch and has stale checks plus an uneditable branch, so automation should not start another fix until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, resolve the stale failing checks, and handle the uneditable fork branch.

options.title: Replace with a same-repo PR
options.body: Close or supersede the fork candidate and land the same UI-only resolver behavior from a maintainer-owned branch with fresh proof.

options.title: Leave queued behind the PR
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker until the open candidate PR is either merged or explicitly closed as not viable.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, resolve the stale failing checks, and handle the uneditable fork branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the channel UI/catalog refactor that created the current metadata-driven resolver path.
